That one isn't mine to answer. Dosing steroids, microdose or otherwise, is a conversation for a doctor, ideally one who can run bloodwork and look at your health history. I won't give amounts or a protocol, and there's no version of "safe" I can vouch for from a coach's seat.

What I can do is make the natural side work harder: progression, protein and eating enough, sleep, and a program built around your schedule. If you tell me what's pushing you toward this, whether it's a stalled lift or a physique goal, I'll help you with that part.
